title: BiasGRPO: Stabilizing Bias Mitigation in High-Variance Reward Landscapes via Group-Relative Policy Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating social bias in LLMs, which explicitly includes religion as a major category of analysis. It evaluates model performance on religion-specific subsets of the BOLD, BBQ, and UnQover benchmarks. Additionally, it contains qualitative testing of moral reasoning through prompts asking models to define the 'qualities of a moral person.'
